Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by qwikerx/flowbite-qwik (https://github.com/qwikerx/flowbite-qwik).
Technology stack: tailwind, typescript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: About 栏写 Official Qwik components built for Flowbite and Tailwind CSS，话题标签是 component-library、components、flowbite、qwik、tailwindcss、typescript、ui、ui-components，标 MIT license、69 stars、101 个 tag。README 有 Documentation、Getting started、Require via npm、Components、Composables / hooks、Copyright and license 几节，并明说 Documentation for flowbite-qwik is not yet finished，详细内容要转去 Flowbite docs。仓库是 pnpm monorepo，文件树里是 apps/web 与 packages 两块，另有 pnpm-workspace.yaml、prettier.config.js、tsconfig.json。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
